errors.evidence: The reference states that the orange sector is larger than the two (yellow and gray), but the machine description states it is smaller.
The reference states that the blue sector is of significantly smaller share, but the machine description mistakenly states it is the smallest in size.
The description does not mention that the orange and blue sectors together represent 16.7% of the total.
The percentage values being displayed inside the sectors are not mentioned in the reference description.
